status: Reviewer-authored semantic acceptance expectations, not executed whole-game sequences

cases.premise: Own acquired eligible device, paid2RP deployment, first genuine friendly accidental destruction, no exclusion, unused debris and rest allowance.
cases.requiredOutcome: After the actual postcombat minute, consume the eligible debris once and refund1RP. Enemy cause is not required.

cases.premise: Deliberately sacrificed device, even if an enemy participates; or actual copied device/noResourceGeneration/no-own-destruction-chain branch.
cases.requiredOutcome: No Recycling entitlement; preserve every separately applicable exclusion. Copied incoming damage alone is not a copied object.

cases.premise: Recipe-596 device records0RP deployment, with GP construction and later repairRP.
cases.requiredOutcome: Zero positive RP refund; neither money, service nor later RP expenditure is reclassified as deployment cost.

cases.premise: Original material was already consumed by a legal Recycling/Salvage/Reaper/Snap operation.
cases.requiredOutcome: Another consumer cannot reuse it. Repair, reconstruction, a new record ID or second physical destruction does not create a new original material opportunity.

cases.premise: Friendly accidental destruction is offered to Scrap Salvage, Scrap Reaper or Volatile; alternatively enemy transfer has no direct enemy hit.
cases.requiredOutcome: Their separate hostile-cause/enemy-hit/root-flag predicates remain. Recycling acceptance does not make these other branches legal.

cases.premise: Crimson Agent8 without Spill;8 with Spill;9 without;9 with current2BG.
cases.requiredOutcome: Cap3;6;6;current2 remains2 with max6. No cap9 or refill.

cases.premise: Shaman12/13 at full ordinary Totem capacity; proposed extra Echo with no free slot.
cases.requiredOutcome: Cap1/2. Ordinary replacement chooses an existing Totem. Optional Echo cannot evict. Ending the parent ends its dependent Echo administratively, without a new destruction reward.

cases.premise: Natural1+9 vsDC10 in an ordinary Core binary-effect task versus basic mundane dismantling.
cases.requiredOutcome: Core shifts Success to Failure before collapse; basic dismantling stays Success without that shift. Neither route borrows six-band crafting or harvest critical benefits.

cases.premise: Ilan takes all four regular turns plus a real extra turn, with actual Mobile selected.
cases.requiredOutcome: Each regular turn has one lawful stance choice; extra turn retains its prior choice/used allowance. The devices gain no stance-derived attack bonus and all four printed outcomes remain.

cases.premise: Character records Core Mobile and a separate Monk class stance using existing effects rows/continuation.
cases.requiredOutcome: Keep distinct source IDs, restrictions, spent uses and endpoints. No implicit neutral stance, new widget, new form schema or doubled stance entitlement.

cases.premise: Absent source field, null field and empty array; copied text with already-studied correspondence, exhausted choice and unfinished course.
cases.requiredOutcome: Preserve the four-way evidence distinctions, no duplicate Insight or hidden choice credit and no competency from unfinished work. Translation/key evidence and fluency remain different.

cases.premise: Recipe-200 reserve6instead of7, occupied tools, unspent-dose claim after use or rest claimed for active work.
cases.requiredOutcome: Reject missing prerequisites/duplicate claims. Keep the literal recipe and actual physical histories; synthetic correct arithmetic supplies none of those facts.

cases.premise: A removed W2 had the only Mobility Trauma, while independent Prone/Unconscious source still exists.
cases.requiredOutcome: End the Injury linked to W2, not the independent conditions. HP recovery and Wound treatment do not silently clear every condition.

cases.premise: Two controller rosters, a support-only command, expired service or another controller offered a second same-body offense.
cases.requiredOutcome: Share the actual owner/subject histories and costs; support alone is not offense, but another attack still needs its own lawful permission. New encounter needs its own paid service unit.

cases.premise: Five note amendments applied to the active foundation; old staging README retained separately.
cases.requiredOutcome: Reverse exactly the five note strings to the preserved original chapter with its original LF newlines. Fresh dispatch README uses its own manifest hash; do not assert the historical README hash matches the new text.

cases.premise: Blank/reopened sheet contains correct source labels and reference values.
cases.requiredOutcome: No source permission, game state, training/accessibility trial, runtime certification, balance or final-flow approval follows from field presence or a source-shaped string.
